messages:
Eli Torres: Hey team — on my first day trying to set up docs. I can view the eng runbook pages but there's no duplicate or edit option. I need to copy the incident template for my team. Who can enable this?
Sam DevEx: hey Eli, welcome! If Duplicate/edit is missing you're probably Org Viewer only. We have a "Docs Editors" group that grants edit rights. @Rae People Ops can add you.
Eli Torres: thanks — I tried searching for "Docs Editors" in settings but didn't see it. My SSO email is eli.torres@redwood.ai.
Rae People Ops: added you to Docs Editors just now. You should get an invite from Notion. If the UI doesn't update, sign out and sign back in.
notion-bot: Invite sent to eli.torres@redwood.ai for group "Docs Editors" 179120001.
Eli Torres: got it and accepted. Duplicate appears. Quick Q: is there an official incident+runbook template to copy, or do teams maintain their own?
Sam DevEx: official template lives in DevEx templates: https://redwood.notion.site/devex/runbook-incident-template. Copy it, then add an "Owner" property and set visibility to your team. If you want the variant added to the org library, open a docs-templates PR in the internal repo and tag it visibility:org.
Eli Torres: perfect. Also, some command blocks are locked on the page I tried to copy. Should I ask the owner to unlock or is there a recommended flow?
Rae People Ops: owners sometimes lock critical command blocks to prevent accidental edits. If you need an editable copy, request owner unlock or export page to markdown and import to your workspace. If you want the locked blocks preserved but editable for your team, ask the page owner to create an unlocked duplicate and mark it as template-team.
Eli Torres: great, I'll request an unlocked copy and then file a PR to add our variant to the template library. One last thing: onboarding checklist location?
Sam DevEx: People Ops checklists: https://redwood.notion.site/people-ops/onboarding. Copy "New Hire: Eng onboarding" and add any infra-specific tasks as linked items.
Eli Torres: awesome, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Sam DevEx: ping #devex if you want a 10-min walkthrough of templates.
